description: Sets Egeria up to receive the OpenLineage events Airflow publishes: catalogs the openlineage.events Kafka topic (filled by the shared-infra OpenLineage proxy) and makes it the OpenLineageKafkaListener connector's catalog target. Re-runs after a demo reset, which deletes that set-up. This batch is the only thing that catalogues openlineage.events (owner 2026-11-12); the Coco Data Hub tutorial notebook skips it when the topic exists.
